# Nero Barbers — pitch notes

*Auto-generated from the Google listing. Verify before you quote anything.*

## Why this one
- **142 reviews at 4.8★** — the reputation is already earned. It just has nowhere to land.
- **No website on the Google listing.** Someone searches "barber shop Richmond", finds you, and has nothing to click.
- **Takes bookings** — a click-to-call button converts this directly.

## Getting to the owner
Phone on the listing: **(03) 9428 0000**. Call, or better, walk in.

Best window for hospitality: **weekday 1:30–2:30pm** — after the rush, before close. Never on a weekend.

## The 30-second open
> "Hi — are you the owner? I'll be quick.
> Nero Barbers has 142 reviews at 4.8 stars, but there's no website on your Google listing.
> So I built you one. Here — *(hand them the phone)*
> Use it free for 30 days. If you like it, it's A$1,000 for the year and I keep it running.
> If you don't, I take it down and you owe nothing."

Show first, quote second. Do not lead with the price.

## Pricing that doesn't end after one payment
- **A$1,000 first year** — build + domain + hosting + SSL + unlimited content updates
- **A$390 per year after** — hosting, domain, maintenance
- Free for 30 days; unpaid on day 31 means the site comes down, domain held 30 days

Hosting sits with you, so "it comes down" is just how a subscription works — not a threat you have to enforce awkwardly.

## Objections
| They say | You say |
|---|---|
| "Instagram is enough" | "Instagram doesn't show up when someone Googles barber shop near Richmond. And it can't be tapped to call you." |
| "Too expensive" | "A$1,000 a year is under A$3 a day. And the first 30 days cost nothing." |
| "I need to think" | "Nothing to decide — it's already built. Use it free for 30 days. I'll come back Thursday." |
| "My nephew does websites" | "Great — I'll hand him the domain once it's set up. Don't lose the next 30 days of customers while you wait." |
| "Who updates it?" | "Included. Message me any change, any time, for the whole year." |

## On the day they say yes
1. Register the domain (~A$20/yr, .com.au needs an ABN)
2. Rebuild with `--live` to drop the noindex tag
3. Deploy, then **paste the URL into their Google Business Profile "Website" field — do this with them, in person.** It's the single highest-value action in this whole process.
4. Collect real photos and confirm every menu price
